# Vendored brand assets

`tokens.css` and `ar-pattern.css` are vendored from
[theagentrouter/brand-assets](https://github.com/theagentrouter/brand-assets) @ f18e304.

**Do not edit these files here** — change them in brand-assets and re-sync.
Fonts live in `static/fonts/`, logo cuts in `static/img/brand/` (same provenance).
`ar-wordmark-white-transparent.svg` is a local derivative (backing rect stripped)
pending transparent cuts landing upstream.
